name: AirPlay 2 Speaker for Kiosk Satellite (multiroom and sync)
description: Makes this kiosk an AirPlay 2 speaker that joins multi-room groups and plays in sync with HomePods and other AirPlay 2 speakers, using shairport-sync and NQPTP. Pick it under Settings > Media Player > Player: it plays through the kiosk's own output, so the echo canceller, the media volume and the assistant's duck apply, and Now Playing shows the track. AirPlay 2 timing needs UDP ports 319 and 320: where Android won't let the app open them, a moment of root (Shizuku running as root, or su such as Magisk) redirects them to ports the app can open. Not affiliated with Apple.
author: Kieran Waugh

settings.title: Speaker name
settings.description: The name in the AirPlay menu of an iPhone, iPad or Mac.

settings.title: Sync offset (ms)
settings.description: Moves playback against other speakers in a group. Negative plays earlier. Tune by ear with a HomePod in the same room.

settings.title: Log sync statistics
settings.description: Writes shairport-sync's sync figures to the app log every few seconds.
